name: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences & Technology (SCTIMST)
tagline: Nation's referral centre for cardiac, neuro and biomedical‑device care
summary: SCTIMST (Thiruvananthapuram) is an Institution of National Importance that combines super‑specialty cardiac and neurological care with biomedical‑device R&D. It serves as a tertiary referral centre…
description: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences & Technology (SCTIMST) is an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science & Technology. The institute combines a tertiary referral super‑specialty hospital, a Biomedical Technology Wing and a public‑health/teaching centre.

SCTIMST specialises in advanced cardiac and neurological care and in indigenous development of biomedical devices and materials. The hospital offers services such as pediatric cardiac surgery, cardiac electrophysiology, epilepsy surgery and deep‑brain stimulation, and the campus supports device design, testing and translation.

The institute functions as a regional referral centre: clinicians and hospitals send patients for complex cardiovascular, thoracic and neurological interventions and for specialist diagnostics. SCTIMST is also a teaching and research university offering postgraduate and doctoral programmes in medicine, bioengineering and public health.

Visiting SCTIMST gives a view of India’s integrated medicine‑plus‑technology approach — expect specialised clinics, technology labs (BMT wing) and a public‑health research unit (Achutha Menon Centre). Confirm appointments and visiting arrangements before you travel.
highlights: Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science & Technology.
Three wings: tertiary referral hospital, Biomedical Technology Wing, Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies.
Known for advanced cardiac and neurological procedures (including pediatric cardiac surgery, epilepsy surgery, DBS).
Hospital listed with ~253 beds and functions as a tertiary referral centre for cardiovascular and neurologic diseases.
Active biomedical device R&D, indigenous device development and clinical translation.
University status offering postgraduate, doctoral and postdoctoral programmes.

sections.heading: Background
body: SCTIMST began as an advanced centre for medical specialities and is declared an Institution of National Importance by an Act of Parliament. The institute purposely brings medicine and technology together to deliver specialist clinical care while developing biomedical devices and diagnostics.
The campus splits into a hospital wing (clinical services), a Biomedical Technology Wing (device R&D and testing) and the Achutha Menon Centre for health‑science teaching and research.

sections.heading: What to see and do
body: For non‑patients, the most relevant areas are the hospital wards/clinics (cardiology, CVTS, neurology, neurosurgery) and the Biomedical Technology Wing where device research and testing happen. Public lectures or convocation events are occasionally open to invited guests — check the institute calendar.

If you are a patient or referring clinician, use the hospital registration system and carry a referral letter and previous records. The institute runs specialised clinics and diagnostic units that manage complex referrals from across Kerala and neighbouring states.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: Registration and new patient consultation are normally handled through the hospital registration counters or the patient portal. The institute recommends fixing prior appointments; the registration page on the SCTIMST site lists weekday registration and consultation slots (confirm current timings before you travel).

SCTIMST sits within Thiruvananthapuram city near the Government Medical College / Poojappura area and is reachable by city bus, taxi and local transport. Contact the hospital information desk or the relevant division before you travel to confirm clinic times, referral procedures and visitor rules.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Weekdays — schedule outpatient or specialist appointments in advance; confirm registration hours before you travel.
visitorInfo.howToReach: SCTIMST is in central Thiruvananthapuram (Poojappura/near Government Medical College). Reach by taxi or city bus from Thiruvananthapuram Central railway station or the airport; ask local drivers for 'SCTIMST (Sree Chitra)'.
etiquette: Bring a referral letter and copies of prior medical records for first registration.
Fix appointments in advance — new registrations and specialist clinics follow scheduled weekday slots (confirm current hours).
Contact the specific clinical division (cardiology, neurology, CVTS) by phone or email for referral advice before travelling.
Confirm visiting rules, ID and required forms with patient‑services; the institute posts notices and corrigenda on its news/recruitment pages.
